title: Israeli Couscous and Vegetable Patties
description: Kid-friendly patties packed with grated onion, carrot and zucchini and cooked Israeli couscous, pan-fried or baked.

steps.text: Grate the onion, carrot and zucchini with a grater or food processor. Squeeze out the excess liquid with both hands and transfer to a bowl.
Add the cooked Israeli couscous (cooked according to the packet instructions), eggs, breadcrumbs, salt and pepper and mix.

Heat a non-stick frying pan with 2 tbsp oil. Shape patties with wet hands or spoon the mixture into the pan and fry for about 2 minutes on each side. Drain on paper towel and serve hot or at room temperature.
To bake instead, preheat the oven to 180°C and place the patties on a tray lined with baking paper. Spray with oil and bake for 15-20 minutes until golden.
